Results-driven professional with 8 years of experience in business analysis, product ownership, and quality assurance within the digital payments industry. Hands-on exposure to requirement gathering, writing user stories, acceptance criteria, and functional documentation (BRD/FSD). Experienced in collaborating with stakeholders and technical teams to support gap analysis, process flows, and payment system implementations. Currently enhancing BA expertise while leveraging strong payments domain knowledge and Agile/Scrum experience to bridge business and technology needs effectively. Experienced in digital payments systems, including cards (ATM & POS),Tokenization, IMPS, UPI, AEPS, NEFT, RTGS, SWIFT, and cross-border payment solutions, with hands-on knowledge of transaction flows, clearing and Settlement.

Supported payment gateway integration's, API-based solutions, and fraud detection mechanisms.
Conducted load and stress testing to validate switch performance under peak transaction volumes.
